Bogura: Dr Muhammad Shahidullah in Language Movement
2023-02-08T21:57:27+06:00 | Star Special
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-multimedia/news-multimedia/news/bogura-dr-muhammad-shahidullah-language-movement-3242651

In February 1948, Khawaja Nazimuddin opposed proposal to recognise Bangla as the state language.

After the opposition, Bogura students erupted in protest. Linguist Dr Muhammad Shahidullah also took part in the Language Movement there.

In the 71st year of the movement, learn about Bogura's leading role in today's Star Special.
